claim_results.claim: AVGen-Bench defines a task-driven text-to-audio-video prompt set spanning 3 main domains and 11 real-world sub-categories (Figure 3; Figure 4).
claim_results.limitation: The raw prompt JSON verifies subcategory coverage; the domain wording is inferred from released benchmark/scoring structure.
claim_results.observation: Released prompts contain 235 prompts across 11 category files; scoring code exposes 3 evaluation groups.

claim_results.claim: AVGen-Bench evaluates T2AV systems with joint audio-visual metrics plus fine-grained modules for scene text, face identity, pitch, speech, physics, and holistic semantic alignment (Figure 5).
claim_results.limitation: This verifies metric/module availability and score formula, not full model evaluation reruns.
claim_results.observation: Aggregate code defines 11 dimensions across 3 groups and released source exposes 11 expected evaluator modules.

claim_results.claim: Compared with existing benchmarks, AVGen-Bench uses higher-complexity prompts and covers all audio modalities with a broader metric set (Table 1).
claim_results.limitation: No independent rerun or audit of prior benchmark prompt complexity was performed.
claim_results.observation: The release includes a benchmark-comparison asset and 11 metric dimensions; prompt mean length is 70.2 words.

claim_results.claim: Quantitative evaluation reveals that current T2AV models can score well on aesthetics while failing fine-grained semantic reliability, including text rendering, speech coherence, physical reasoning, and pitch control (Table 2; Figure 2).
claim_results.limitation: The evidence recomputes patterns from released aggregate README values, not raw evaluator outputs.
claim_results.observation: Parsed 13 released leaderboard rows; high-basic/low-fine models: ['Veo 3.1-fast', 'Veo 3.1-quality', 'Wan2.6', 'Seedance-1.5 Pro'].

claim_results.claim: Automated fine-grained scores correlate with expert human judgments across six evaluated dimensions (Table 3).
claim_results.limitation: Expert human judgment data are required to recompute correlations and were not found in released artifacts.

claim_results.claim: Repeated-run and prompt-subset analyses show AVGen-Bench produces stable model comparisons under MLLM-assisted evaluation and prompt resampling (Table 5; Figure 6).
claim_results.limitation: Prompt-subset/repeated-run cached outputs are required for numeric stability reproduction and were not found.
claim_results.observation: Stability script present: True; repeat output artifacts found: [].

title: AVGen-Bench: A Task-Driven Benchmark for Multi-Granular Evaluation of Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
